name: us-form-5472-foreign-owned-us
description: Decide whether a US corporation that is 25% foreign-owned, a foreign corporation with a US trade or business, or a US single-member LLC wholly owned by one foreign person (a foreign-owned US disregarded entity) must file Form 5472 for tax year 2026, and what goes on it. Covers who is a 25% foreign shareholder and a related party (section 318 attribution with the 10% substitution), reportable transactions by Part IV line, Part V contributions and distributions for disregarded entities, the pro forma Form 1120, the dedicated fax and Ogden mailing address, Form 7004 extensions, the EIN on Form SS-4, the USD 25,000 penalty per related party per year under 26 U.S.C. 6038A(d) and its continuation penalty, reasonable cause, the small corporation and de minimis record-keeping exceptions, and the open assessment period under 6501(c)(8). Uses Form 5472 (Rev. December 2023) with its Instructions (Rev. December 2024). Trigger on "Form 5472", "foreign-owned LLC", "pro forma 1120", "foreign-owned U.
